messages:
elaine: FYI — Acme Pharma is pushing to convert PAYG -> 6mo committed, but procurement insists on carving out the on-prem infra SKU. They want a one-off concession for the infra line and net-45 payment terms. PO attached (PO-91234).

matt: numbers? how much of a concession are they asking for?

elaine: asking for 40% off infra SKU for the first 3 months. That equates to ~$48k discount vs list for Q1. They said legal will only sign if net-45 is in place.

jyoti: That size exceeds our standard delegated discount. Need Deal Desk escalation + pricing exception. Elaine, can you open the pricing-exception form and link the PO?

elaine: done — form submitted: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PRX-7345, included PO and procurement note (mentions VAT passthrough).

henry: Quick read — concession seems targeted (infra-only) and timeboxed to 3 months. We can consider conditional approval but cap total one-off at $30k. Need legal to approve net-45 and VAT handling. :thinking_face:

matt: Agreed with Henry. Can we limit the concession to infra SKU only, and add clause: no retroactive credits for usage spikes?

elaine: will add that clause in the addendum draft. Also procurement asked for invoice reminder schedule (30/15 days) before net-45 due date to reduce risk.

procurement-bot: PO uploaded to S3: s3://company-po/PO-91234.pdf — checksum OK.

jyoti: Final from Finance: conditional approval granted for up to $30,000 one-off concession (infra SKU only), timeboxed to first 3 billing cycles, subject to legal sign-off on net-45 and VAT passthrough. Revenue Ops to update billing terms and create billing schedule. Please confirm acceptance in the pricing-exception ticket.

revenue-ops: noted — will create custom billing term (net-45) and schedule reminders as requested. Will also set a special SKU discount line on the invoice for tracking.

matt: Thanks — AE will confirm with customer and get legal to sign the addendum. :thumbsup:

elaine: closing loop here. I'll update PRX-7345 with the signed addendum once legal returns it. :white_check_mark:
